name: gdoc-to-overleaf
description: Google Doc to Overleaf: a Claude Code skill that converts a Google Doc into LaTeX, optionally to a venue's style guide, and puts it in Overleaf.

plugins.name: gdoc-to-overleaf
plugins.description: Convert a Google Doc into a LaTeX project in Overleaf, inferring theorems, captions, display maths and code from formatting, conforming to a style guide on request, and checking every word against the doc.
